How this master class works

The master class is 21 chapters. Each chapter is a rich, hands-on lesson that opens into its 2 to 4 sections, the individual topics. Every section teaches on three levels (pick your depth) and drops you into an interactive Studio to do it, not just read it. Taught by Droobi, aligned to PMBOK, flavored for water throughout. 60 sections in all, covering the complete body of knowledge.

Foundation

New to PM? Plain words, every term defined, nothing assumed.

Practitioner

Running jobs? The mechanics and the real how, hands-on.

Leader

Managing a program? Judgment, money, and portfolio scale.
